verdict.rationale: Capacities documents a REST API with Bearer/OAuth auth for accessing, creating and manipulating content, plus an MCP integration path, but there is no evidence that the API exposes full feature parity with the UI (e.g., graph view, daily notes, AI chats, templates, backlinks are UI-only features not shown as API endpoints), and an OpenAPI spec could not be found (404s). missing for 10: comprehensive API/endpoint documentation covering all UI features, explicit parity claims, independent confirmation that API can replicate UI workflows.
